==== @turf/distance, @turf/meta, @turf/invariant, @turf/point-to-line-distance, @turf/nearest-point-on-line, @turf/rhumb-distance, @turf/explode 7.4.0 ====

==== Maritime network: marnet-20km.json ====
Eurostat SeaRoute maritime network (marnet_plus, 20 km), https://github.com/eurostat/searoute — EUPL-1.2.
Oak Ridge National Labs Global Shipping Lane Network enriched with European AIS data. © European Union / Eurostat.
Converted from searoute-ts 2.3.1 (dist/data/marnet-20km.cjs); coordinates rounded to 4 decimals.
